tweet_summary: MNMuse tweets a clearly satirical 'NBA suspension' list for Jaden McDaniels after his viral dunk on Deni Avdija (an Israeli player), demanding a $500K anti-hate donation, antisemitism training, and meetings with the ADL/Silver/Netanyahu — read as a joke about over-the-top consequences.
why_note_decision: The post is obvious satire/joke — the demands (meeting Netanyahu over a basketball dunk, etc.) and the comments thread are unmistakably humorous. The provisional 'overhyped_research_or_product' category is wrong; this is sports humor. Commenters are joking along. No reasonable reader treats this as a real NBA press release, and McDaniels in fact kept playing.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note here is a false positive: the tweet is unmistakable satire/joke about an NBA dunk, not a checkable factual claim. Pedantically 'fact-checking' the satire (e.g. 'McDaniels was not actually suspended') is precisely the failure to avoid.
